sections.title: Sound of the letter ká
paragraphs: This letter is named (ká) /kaː/. Its main sound appears in the word (kék) /ˈkeːk/, which means blue. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say ká
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment, then release it quickly. A voiceless consonant is a sound where your throat does not shake. Keep your voice off. For the second sound, make this same movement, but turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules for ká
paragraphs: In most places, this letter keeps its regular voiceless sound, as in (kutya) /ˈkucɒ/. It changes when it stands right before certain voiced consonants. Assimilation is a change where one sound becomes more like the sound next to it. Through assimilation, the letter sounds like the one in (lökdös) /ˈløɡdøʃ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with ká
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of breath at the start of a word. Many learners say the first sound of kick with a small puff of air. Keep the air release dry and sharp, like the sound after the s in skin.
